messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: metering-service token_count drift detected. alert_id=met-drift-2026-03-15-01. Metric aggregate_token_count deviating >12% vs expected over last 30m. Rule fired during reconciler run. Potential customer overage flags. On-call: @eli. Runbook: https://rwd.internal/runbooks/metering-drift
eli: ack — taking this. logs + quick triage coming up.
maya: joining. seeing sustained consumer lag on ingestion-kafka topic metering.events. consumer lag ~250k. Also seeing S3 timeouts in metering-ingest logs.
alex: FYI billing team: we've seen a handful of auto-overage emails go out (~0.3% of active customers). Not widespread but real. Need suppression ASAP if possible.
jamal: we already have 2 customer tickets open reporting sudden usage spikes. I'll hold responses until we have a comms line.
eli: triage plan: 1) check ingest consumer health 2) suppress auto overage emails 3) run reconciliation for recent window 4) identify impacted customers and draft credits. Doing step 1 now.
eli: kubectl -n metering get pods -l app=metering-consumer -o wide
# metering-consumer-57x   0/1   CrashLoopBackOff   4   10m
eli: looks like one consumer pod had repeated S3 write timeouts -> restarting.
maya: logs show S3 PutObject timeouts and exponential retries causing backpressure. Also noticed a subset of events with timestamps ahead/behind host time — possible clock skew on some producers.
eli: executing suppression endpoint:
curl -XPOST https://admin.rwd/api/billing/flags/suppress -d '{"scope":"auto-overage","until":"2026-03-15T02:30:00Z","reason":"ingest-lag-recon"}'
eli: suppression request sent, response 202. Added tag suppress_id=sup-2645012345.
support-rca-bot: NOTE: suppression prevents new overage emails but does not retract emails already sent. See billing ops runbook.
alex: acknowledged. We'll coordinate credits for any customers that were incorrectly notified. Add metric tag so we can audit later.
jamal: comms template for tickets: "We're investigating unexpected usage spikes. Automated overage emails are suppressed while we reconcile. We'll follow up with a resolution and any credits within ~2 hours." Copying to ticket responses.
maya: mitigation in progress: bumping S3 client retry/backoff and enabling local-disk-batching fallback in the consumer config. Rolling restart now. Config diff:
--- a/deploy/met-consumer.yaml
+++ b/deploy/met-consumer.yaml
@@
- env:
-  - name: S3_RETRY_COUNT
-    value: "3"
+ env:
+  - name: S3_RETRY_COUNT
+    value: "8"
+  - name: ENABLE_LOCAL_BUFFER
+    value: "true"
eli: rolling restart done. consumer lag trending down 250k -> 40k in ~6m.
eli: starting reconciliation job for window 2026-03-15T00:00:00Z -> now.
python tools/reconcile_counts.py --since '2026-03-15T00:00:00Z' --until now --output /tmp/recon-2645012345.csv &
maya: kicking off quick integrity query to find duplicate/overcounted customers:
SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS events, min(event_ts) AS first, max(event_ts) AS last
FROM metering_events
WHERE event_ts >= '2026-03-15T00:00:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING count(*) > expected_threshold;
eli: preliminary results: a cohort of ~48 customers concentrated in eu-west-1 show +12-18% extra counts vs expected. Likely duplicates from retries + delayed batches.
alex: I'll assemble a provisional credits list from the recon CSV once it's ready. We should also prepare a rollback plan for any billed overages.
jamal: updating open tickets: "We've suppressed automated overage notifications and are reconciling usage. If you're impacted we'll issue a credit; ETA ~2 hours."
maya: action items (current):
- suppression active until 2026-03-15T02:30:00Z (can be extended)
- finish reconciliation and generate affected_customer_list.csv
- apply credits for false overage charges
- revert suppression only after manual sanity checks
- postmortem: root cause S3 endpoint degradation + producer clock skew; remediate both
eli: creating incident record https://incidents.rwd/2645012345 . Assigning postmortem to eng-infra & billing-ops. Tagging #severity-2.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=partial_mitigated; mitigations applied: consumer restart, local buffering, suppression; reconciliation running. responders=[eli,maya,alex,jamal].
eli: will monitor reconcile progress and update channel when credits list is ready. If anyone sees fresh overage emails after suppression flag, ping me directly.
jamal: noted. prepping customer comm for proactive outreach after reconciliation.
maya: capturing logs and metrics snapshot and saving to /artifacts/incidents/2645012345/ for postmortem.
eli: final for now — keeping channel open. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
